title: corpus/gameability/P-NNN.json
description: A gameability probe's degenerate response (AD-9, AD-19): the compliant-looking answer, one response per interaction plan step (a command step's streams and exit code, or a tool-call step's error flag and structured result), which tea-evaluate run answers the plan from with no target launched. eval-quality keeps the probe's degenerateResponse as prose, so the bytes live here, in the corpus. tea-evaluate check requires one entry for every plan step and no other, each of its step's kind, and refuses an exit code the step's registry entry declares as infrastructure. The tea-evaluate runtime owns this schema.

steps.description: The response each plan step receives, by its stepId.

stdout.description: What the step prints to standard output.

stderr.description: What the step prints to standard error.

oneOf.description: A tool-call step's answer (Story 1.10): the tool's error flag and, when it returns one, its structured result.

isError.description: The MCP envelope's error flag, recorded as responseStatus 1 when true and 0 when false.

structuredResult.description: The tool's structured result, recorded as the response body; absent when the tool returns none.
